title: How ALKU Cut Time to First Deal in Half by Scaling Repetition
summary: How ALKU cut time to first closed deal in half and scaled its internship program to 300+ reps with Hyperbound.
body_markdown:
## At a glance


> “We definitely cannot imagine going back to the ways we were doing things before.”


Michael O’Brien, Senior Director of Sales Strategy


The problem


## Not enough at-bats


ALKU’s model depends on repetition. But in reality, reps weren’t getting enough at-bats.


1. 01


They could make hundreds of calls and only speak to a handful of people. Most conversations never happened, which meant most learning never happened either.


2. 02


Roleplay was already known to be one of the most effective parts of training, but it couldn’t keep up.


3. 03


As the internship program scaled to hundreds of reps, training hit a wall. There weren’t enough managers or teammates to run the volume of practice needed to build skill.


Reps weren’t struggling because they weren’t working hard. They were struggling because they didn’t have enough chances to practice.


> “Only maybe 5–10 out of 200 people they call pick up… so for them to get those repetitions, it could take months.”


Michael O’Brien, Senior Director of Sales Strategy


The solution


## From months to hours


Hyperbound changed one thing: it gave reps unlimited repetition. Instead of waiting weeks to accumulate real conversations, reps could simulate them on demand, running through full calls over and over again.


01


Use case


Practice


### Reps gained experience faster and built confidence earlier.


Before Hyperbound, it could take weeks or months to accumulate enough real conversations to improve. Now reps can simulate that same volume of experience in a single session, practicing more often and building confidence before stepping into live calls.


And they’re doing so in an environment that won’t cost them real relationships with clients. That compression changed how quickly reps develop skill.


> “What used to take a month… we can now get done in an hour and a half.”


Andrew Bull, CEO


02


Use case


Practice


### Training scaled across the organization.


ALKU expanded its internship program to 300+ participants without increasing coaching capacity.


What once required constant manager involvement could now happen independently across hundreds of reps at once.


> “They rave about Hyperbound… it’s been such a game changer for them and such a confidence booster.”


Michael O’Brien, Senior Director of Sales Strategy


03


Use case


Perform


### From practice to Hyperbound Perform


Before Hyperbound, ALKU had limited visibility into what was happening on calls. They weren’t recording any calls with prospects or clients, so coaching depended on managers being present in the moment.


With[Hyperbound Perform](https://www.hyperbound.ai/product/hyperbound-perform) , that changed. Managers can now review real conversations, understand where reps are struggling, and connect that directly back to targeted practice.


> “Our managers have the ability to actually speak with their AMs about areas that they could work on.”


James Cassin-Reed, VP of Revenue Strategy


Hyperbound’s impact


## Faster ramp, better reps, scalable training


What used to take around 6 months now takes closer to 3. Reps are closing their first opportunities in half the time, accelerating the path from hiring to revenue contribution.


> “The biggest impact has been a faster ramp curve. Our reps are getting up to speed quicker and showing up more prepared from day one.”


Michael O’Brien, Senior Director of Sales Strategy


At ALKU, the goal wasn’t to improve training. It was to remove the constraints that slowed down performance. For years, skill development was tied to how many real conversations a rep could get.


By removing call volume as the bottleneck, ALKU changed that dynamic entirely. Reps no longer wait weeks to build experience; they build it before it ever matters.


When that happens, ramp, productivity, and overall performance all speed up. The result is a faster path from hiring to performance across the whole organization.
